thread:
maria: Heads-up — noisy GPU capacity alerts paged on-call 3x last night, mostly around 02:14-02:40 UTC. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/db/gpu-capacity (screenshot in #incidents). We should decide paging vs ticketing rules.

jon: Saw that. Most were short bursts when batch jobs drained nodes and autoscaler kicked. Pages for 3-4m then resolved.

kevin: Proposal: page only on sustained cluster-level scarcity. Short spikes -> create ticket/alert in infra queue. Suggest grouping by cluster + pool, and use a duration/hysteresis. Example PromQL idea:
```promql
(sum by(cluster) (gpu_allocated) / sum by(cluster) (gpu_capacity)) > 0.92
for 10m
```
That keeps pages for true capacity pressure.

sasha: Also add mute windows for scheduled node drains/maintenance and known autoscaler flaps (we have calendar entries). We should automatically suppress pages during maintenance windows and send a ticket instead. @oncall-team FYI.

maria: Agreed. Also add a secondary condition: page if >10 pods pending for 10m in the cluster (shows user-visible impact). Prometheus check: `count(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"}) by (cluster) > 10 for 10m`. Short spikes under those thresholds -> ticket.

sre-bot: Note: draft rule created in staging prometheus ruleset. PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/prometheus/-/merge_requests/312 (staging only).

jon: Routing: Critical pages -> L2 oncall (pagerduty critical). Capacity warnings (ticket) -> infra queue, with auto-assign to capacity-owners. Escalation: if critical not acked in 5m, escalate to eng-sre lead. Runbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/gpu-capacity.

kevin: I'll open a PR that includes: 1) new rule with 10m for cluster-level page, 2) ticket-only alert for 3m spikes, 3) grouping labels (cluster, pool, region), 4) mute window support via `ingress_silence` annotations, and 5) pagerduty routing config.

maria: Great. Can you also add a short blurb to the SLO dashboard noting the policy so product teams understand paging thresholds? We'll review in triage tomorrow 10:30am UTC.

jon: 👍 thanks — will add to the triage agenda and check the staging alerts after your PR is up.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/prometheus/-/merge_requests/313 — includes tests and a screenshot of firing alerts in staging.

sasha: Leaving a note: consider a 1-hour dampening mute for flapping caused by spot eviction waves in us-west-2; otherwise pages get noisy.

maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
